capabilities.lead: Systems that run the business and apps that deliver user experience are designed on different principles. Xiora has hands-on experience in both — we propose the right shape for each use case.
cap.systems.1.title: Business Systems
cap.systems.1.desc: The operational backbone past spreadsheets. CRM, deal management, inventory, ordering, shifts, reservations — systems that actually run in the field.
cap.systems.2.title: SaaS Products
cap.systems.2.desc: From SaaS MVP to multi-tenant architecture, billing and operations monitoring. Built on lessons from running Kigen and the XCloud series ourselves.
cap.apps.1.title: Web Apps
cap.apps.1.desc: Login, sign-up, payments, account pages, search experiences. End-to-end web apps from entry to checkout, built on Next.js / TypeScript.
cap.apps.2.title: AI Apps
cap.apps.2.desc: RAG knowledge search, AI chat, AI agents, LINE / Slack bots. Sharp single-purpose apps with AI as the lead.
lifecycle.lead: We don't stop at hand-off. With four in-house products under our belt, we own building, launching, operating and scaling.
lifecycle.build.desc: Requirements, UX and architecture are aligned directly with the founder. Built on Next.js / TypeScript / Supabase / OpenAI — pragmatic, working software first.
lifecycle.launch.desc: Production deploy on Vercel / Cloud Run. Domain, SSL, analytics, logs, monitoring and access control all set up for a safe launch.
lifecycle.operate.desc: Maintenance, audit logs, guardrails, cost monitoring, SLA. Keeping AI and business systems running reliably.
lifecycle.scale.desc: Continuous iteration against KPIs. Feature growth, tenant expansion, AI model swaps, productizing into SaaS — we play the long game with you.
